# TradingView

> TradingView is a comprehensive charting platform and social network for traders offering real-time market data, technical analysis tools, and broker reviews across stocks, forex, cryptocurrencies, and global indices.

TradingView provides traders and investors with access to live charts, quotes, and market analysis across multiple asset classes including equities, indices, cryptocurrencies, and forex. The platform combines professional-grade charting tools with community features and broker integration.

## Key Topics

## Core Platform

- [TradingView — Track All Markets](https://www.tradingview.com): TradingView homepage: charting platform and social network for traders

- [TradingView Subscriptions: Pricing and Features](https://www.tradingview.com/pricing): TradingView subscription plans and feature comparison

## Market Data & Overview

- [Markets Today — Quotes, Charts, and Events — TradingView](https://www.tradingview.com/markets): Market overview with stock, forex, crypto quotes and indices
- [Major Indices — Quotes and Overview — TradingView](https://www.tradingview.com/markets/indices/quotes-major): Global major indices overview with real-time quotes

- [PX1 Index Charts and Quotes — TradingView](https://www.tradingview.com/symbols/EURONEXT-PX1): CAC 40 Index chart from EURONEXT Paris
- [Japan 225 Chart – NI225 Quote — TradingView](https://www.tradingview.com/symbols/TVC-NI225): Live Japan 225 Nikkei index chart with forecasts
- [000001 Index Charts and Quotes — TradingView](https://www.tradingview.com/symbols/SSE-000001): SSE Composite Index chart from Shanghai Stock Exchange
